limitations: Every visible English record is examined; figure aliases are excluded as independent exercises.
Text only: no licensed media is opened, copied or provided to an AI tool.
Regex extraction supports audit and production planning, not a guarantee of visual geometry completeness.
No-prop-documented means no supported prop match in current text; it does not prove equipment-free performance. A floor/ground surface is assumed as part of the scene.
Dimensions, materials, stack-vs-plate mechanisms and hidden accessories often need owner review.
Unresolved generic load/rope/machine rows are retained rather than silently guessed.
Priority is an ordinal planning judgment from exercise count, not measured production time.
Variants may share a reusable model; parent links do not automatically count parent coverage.
